title: Serious Sam - The Second Encounter - join a LAN game
fleetres_block:
call "%~dp0FLEETRES.BAT"
rem WHERE THE HOST ADDRESS COMES FROM - first one that exists wins:
rem   1. the first argument to this .bat
rem   2. lanhost.txt beside this file        (per-title override)
rem   3. C:\Games\lanhost.txt                (fleet-wide; one line, host IP)
rem   4. only then, ask at the console
rem A bare prompt hangs forever on an unattended box, which looks exactly like
rem a game that failed to start.
rem
rem This block sits in the FLEETRES slot deliberately: it must run BEFORE the
rem set "GAMEARGS=..." line below, because cmd expands %HOSTIP% at the moment
rem that set runs. Resolving it later silently produces "+connect" with no
rem address and the game sits at its main menu.
set "HOSTIP=%~1"
if not defined HOSTIP if exist "%~dp0lanhost.txt" for /f "usebackq eol=; tokens=1 delims= " %%A in ("%~dp0lanhost.txt") do if not defined HOSTIP set "HOSTIP=%%A"
if not defined HOSTIP if exist "C:\Games\lanhost.txt" for /f "usebackq eol=; tokens=1 delims= " %%A in ("C:\Games\lanhost.txt") do if not defined HOSTIP set "HOSTIP=%%A"
if not defined HOSTIP set /p "HOSTIP=IP address of the machine hosting the game: "
if not defined HOSTIP (
    echo.
    echo  No host address given - nothing to join.
    echo  Put the host machine IP on the first line of C:\Games\lanhost.txt
    echo  and run this shortcut again.
    ping -n 6 127.0.0.1 >nul
    exit
)
echo  Connecting to %HOSTIP% ...
> "%~dp0Scripts\Game_startup.ini" echo // written by the launcher at every start - do not edit
>>"%~dp0Scripts\Game_startup.ini" echo // PersistentSymbols.ini is NOT the place for this: the engine
>>"%~dp0Scripts\Game_startup.ini" echo // rewrites that file on exit and would overwrite the mode.
>>"%~dp0Scripts\Game_startup.ini" echo sam_bFullScreen=1;
>>"%~dp0Scripts\Game_startup.ini" echo sam_iScreenSizeI=%FR_W%;
>>"%~dp0Scripts\Game_startup.ini" echo sam_iScreenSizeJ=%FR_H%;
>>"%~dp0Scripts\Game_startup.ini" echo gfx_iRefreshRate=%FR_HZ%;

vars.GTITLE: Serious Sam - The Second Encounter - Join LAN

_note: The game also has 'search local network for servers' in its own menu; this shortcut exists because a broadcast that does not arrive is indistinguishable from a server that never started. MARKER is a per-disc .gro and deliberately NOT Install\Bin\SeriousSam.exe, which is the file the CD check itself opens: it is on BOTH Encounters' discs, so it would let the wrong one report success. Same class as BF1942's Setup.ini marker.
